result.title: Thinking in Streams: Proactive Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Recognizing when a requested spatial condition holds in streaming video can require maintaining and updating spatial knowledge across changing viewpoints. We study this capability through proactive spatial reasoning, where a model receives a query in advance and determines whether and when to respond as the stream unfolds. We introduce ProSpace-Bench, comprising nine tasks across object, camera, and scene reasoning, and ProSpace-Train for supervised training. To support spatial decisions, we propose ProSpace-VLM, which injects explicit geometric encodings estimated causally from incoming frames into intermediate VLM layers, using the existing KV cache as spatial memory and spatial token selection for efficient streaming. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between VLMs and humans, while ProSpace-VLM improves timely responses and correct abstention over fine-tuned baselines. Analyses examine how ProSpace-VLM represents previously observed spatial information across changing viewpoints.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究流式视频中的主动空间推理，即预给查询后由模型自行判断空间条件何时成立并决定是否、何时作答；构建了覆盖物体、相机与场景推理的九任务基准 ProSpace-Bench 及训练集 ProSpace-Train，并提出 ProSpace-VLM，将因果估计的几何编码注入 VLM 中间层，用 KV cache 充当空间记忆并以空间 token 选择实现高效流式处理。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及「何时作答／正确弃答」的停止决策与跨视角内部空间状态维护，其 KV cache 作记忆、中间层几何注入与 token 选择可供核查 LVR 的状态更新、证据筛选与停止成本问题；分析部分关于历史空间信息表征的结论也值得对照 latent 内容是否被真正使用。
